value: Browses selectively on shrubs, brush, weeds, and leaves rather than relying only on grass.
fieldResults.normalizationBridge: The observed browsing behavior is a functional feeding differentiator; the generic livestock-only statement is rejected.
Leaves map directly to LEAVES; shrubs and brush map to WOODY_BIOMASS. This does not independently reject GRASSES.
Pasture/grazing supports GRASSES; named grain feeds normalize to SEEDS_GRAINS.
Lake Matano is a lake habitat; aquarium husbandry is not normalized to WORKSHOP.
Urban residence maps to BUILT_ENVIRONMENT; the country-level mountain and desert facts map directly to their broad tokens.
The habitat descriptions map directly; CITY and VILLAGE are rejected because they occur only in proximity statements.
Ants and termites normalize to INSECTS; aardvark cucumber normalizes to FRUIT. SEEDS_GRAINS is not supported.
The exact-species solitary baseline is directly relevant only to operating style; it is not cascaded into unrelated dimensions.

value: Lays eggs among aquatic vegetation without nest building or subsequent parental care.
fieldResults.normalizationBridge: The source-specific reproductive behavior is retained as a biological trait, not converted into civic motivation or personality.

fieldResults.researchQuestion: Does lack of nest building or parental care establish an allowed civic motivation value?
queriesAttempted: Australian lungfish parental care eggs no guarding Queensland Museum
factsFound: No nest is built and young do not appear to receive parental care.
fieldResults.nullRationale: A reproductive-care strategy does not establish ALTRUISTIC, RECIPROCAL, or SELFISH civic motivation.

fieldResults.normalizationBridge: Communal care and coordinated defense directly support TEAMWORK; solitary behavior is rejected for this species.
Rivers normalize to FRESHWATER and adjacent wetlands to WETLAND; DAM is not an allowed habitat token.
High mountain habitat maps to ALPINE and rock cliffs to CLIFF; no canopy or arboreal token is supported.
